plan.title: Disable View-Only Mode and Send Counter Offer

steps.note: Open the existing live auction from the prepared environment.
Go to the buyer's responses view where the Actions menu and counter-offer controls are available.
Confirm the opened event is an auction before testing the auction-specific action.
Click the same View-Only Mode action to disable it.
Attempt the restricted counter-offer action after disabling View-Only Mode.
Assert that the counter offer was successfully initiated, proving the action became available again.
